description: Dutch courses, university Dutch departments, CNaVT exam centres and Dutch schools for children near a capital city (within 40 km), with the nearest option when nothing is local. Pass a capital (e.g. Tokyo) or an ISO country code (e.g. JP). With no arguments, lists the capitals that have a local option. Use it when someone lives outside the Netherlands and Belgium or asks about Dutch classes, the CNaVT exam or a Dutch school in another country.
name: tdd_abroad
title: Learn Dutch abroad
